stance_question.instructions: Using only the claim and all provided articles together, determine whether the available evidence supports or contradicts the claim, or is insufficient. Empty sentence slots are unavailable text.

criteria.NEI: The available articles provide insufficient evidence to support or contradict the claim.
criteria.SUPPORT: The available evidence supports the claim.
criteria.CONTRADICT: The available evidence contradicts the claim.

evidence_instructions: Considering the claim and the full context of all articles, is the sentence with original_index={original_index} in article doc_id={doc_id} part of evidence supporting or contradicting the claim? Include sentences that jointly form evidence with other sentences. Mere topical relevance is not evidence.
